title: Chapter 48 Zerg Reinforcements
content:
Chapter 48 Zerg Reinforcements

The heavy javelin that whistled in was quite powerful. The dog's blade arm kept swinging, but it couldn't stop the large number of javelin volleys.

The sound of "chi chi" continued to ring, and the sharp armor-piercing spearhead pierced the dog's shell, causing damage to the dog.

In this world, the Zerg finally encountered a threatening long-range attack.

The injured dog struggled to get up and evacuated backwards.

The unfortunate dead dog turned into light and disappeared.

1,000 hydralisks, led by three one-star hydralisks, took up a favorable position on the high ground under the close protection of the dog and launched a long-range attack on the army of the bear goblin tribe.

In terms of attack distance, the hydralisk still has some advantages, especially the one-star hydralisk, the upgraded version of the spike attack, the attack power, attack speed and attack distance have been greatly improved.

The three one-star hydralisks have the fastest attack speed, the most accurate attack, and the strongest power. A single spike can knock down a long-armed ogre.

The attack of ordinary hydralisks has the same killing effect on long-armed ogres as it does on bugbear infantry, but their attack speed is much faster than that of long-armed ogres.

The long-armed ogres should have obtained the faith blessing of the bugbear priests in advance. They are very eager to fight. They ignore their companions who keep falling down and keep running forward to throw.

The entire bugbear army follows them in a neat formation and keeps moving forward.

With the long-armed ogres to contain them, even if there are 600 more hydralisks, they will not cause any damage to the main formation of the bugbear army at this time.

Heavy javelins keep flying towards the hydralisks.

The puppies stand beside the hydralisks, using their blade arms and bodies to intercept the flying heavy javelins. Puppies keep falling down, and other puppies make up for them.

Their sacrifice protects the safety of the hydralisks and allows the Zerg's long-range firepower to continue without weakening.

The number of long-armed ogres was decreasing rapidly, and their reduction in numbers also achieved the expected goal, allowing the army of the bugbears to gain enough time to advance safely.

The number of long-armed ogres was twice that of hydralisks. If they continued to fight like this, the entire army of the bugbears would be able to rush to the front of the hydralisks before the long-armed ogres were all eliminated.

At this moment, the bugbear cavalry on both sides of the bugbear army began to charge!

Their target was also the hydralisks!

The current terrain and topography did not have as much impact on mounts like monitor lizards as Wu Qing expected, and the impact on long-armed ogres was also not as expected.

These strange races in this world seem to have a very strong ability to adapt to the environment.

Of course, there must be an impact, but the effect was not as good as expected, which disappointed Wu Qing a little.

The long-armed ogres restrained the long-range attacks of the Zerg hydralisks, the bugbear cavalry quickly charged and attacked, and the main army advanced steadily. This link after link completely suppressed the Zerg.

"Stone throwing!"

When the army of the bear goblins advanced to a certain distance, the effect was not good, but a large number of stone throwing attacks began.

The overwhelming stones flew towards the Zerg army, and all the Zerg within the attack range were attacked by stones.

Seeing such a battlefield situation, Meng couldn't help but clenched his fists, but at this moment, the war had already started, he didn't say much, and kept watching the battlefield quietly, occasionally looking at Wu Qing.

Wu Qing had a calm face, and didn't seem to worry about the Zerg's defeat.

The tactics of the Zerg are actually very simple. The core idea is to protect the hydralisk and fight with the opponent with the zerglings.

Using the zerglings that consume very few resources in exchange for a large amount of resources, earning the price difference, this price difference can be quickly converted into the combat power of the Zerg.

The longer this war of attrition lasts, the greater the profit of the Zerg, and the stronger the Zerg will be. As long as the enemy cannot break this situation, the Zerg will become stronger and stronger if it continues like this.

This time, Wu Qing did not expose the Zerg's ability to burrow underground, otherwise the battle would be easier to fight.

When 2,000 bear goblin cavalry rushed to the vicinity of the hydralisk, a large group of puppies pounced on them.

The crazy close combat of the puppies finally moved Meng. All these puppies rushed to fight with a mentality of death. They completely ignored their own life and death and only wanted to cause damage to the enemy.

This strong will to kill the enemy cannot be compared even by the evil god's believers who have been completely brainwashed and lost themselves.

Seeing the fight of these puppies, Meng even thought that the one who can defeat the evil god in this world must be this Zerg!

The bear goblin cavalry also gained the blessing of faith, and their combat power was above the puppies. Without the long-range support of the hydralisk, the puppies rushed up in batches, fell down in batches, and turned into light and left.

Their desperate fight also brought huge casualties to the bear goblin cavalry. Close combat is the most cruel.

The casualties of the Long-armed Ogres were also very heavy. When they rushed to the front of the Hydralisks, their number was less than 1,000. Almost 1,000 Long-armed Ogres fell in the battle with the Hydralisks.

Seeing that the Bugbears were about to surround the Hydralisks, a large group of puppies rushed into the Long-armed Ogres and started a close combat with them.

The priest in charge of commanding the Bugbears knew that the Hydralisks were going to retreat when he saw this posture.

He immediately prayed silently, consuming a large amount of faith energy, and regardless of the distance consumed, he forcibly blessed the Long-armed Ogres and Bugbear Cavalry in the front again.

This time the blessing was red light, and the blessed long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry entered a frenzy state, and at the cost of a certain amount of rationality, their combat power increased greatly.

"Roar...!"

The blocking puppies were instantly defeated, and the frenzied long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry roared and rushed towards the hydralisk.

Wu Qing had seen how difficult the priest was, and had long been prepared for this move.

Behind the hydralisk, 5,000 puppies that had been on standby suddenly pounced on them and tangled with the frenzied long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry.

The hydralisk took the opportunity to quickly retreat to the next attack site.

The puppies suffered heavy losses at this time, but the dead soldiers of the bugbear clan and the faith energy consumed by the bugbear priest provided a large amount of resources for the system.

In the Zerg territory, 100 puppies or 50 hydralisks would be added almost every two minutes. These puppies and hydralisks would run to the battlefield after hatching.

On the road from the Zerg territory to the battlefield, there were endless Zerg squads running at high speed.

Seeing the Zerg troops about to be surrounded by the Bugbears, Meng couldn't help but ask Wu Qing: "Where are the Zerg reinforcements?"

Wu Qing looked back and saw a team of 100 puppies rushing over.

"Look! Aren't the Zerg reinforcements coming?"

Meng opened his mouth for a long time before saying: "Is this the only reinforcement?"

"Don't worry! The Zerg reinforcements are very many!"
